text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-i-g-g-e-d a c-o-v-e-r b-i-d s-c-h-e-m-e and l-e-f-t c-r-o-s-s c-o-m-p-a-n-y c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t p-r-i-c-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) they d-i-s-c-u-s-s-e-d s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e l-o-g s o-f b-e-n-c-h m-a-r-k n-u-m-b-e-r s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k s.
3) the a-c-t-o-r a-g-r-e-e-d on a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e and l-e-f-t c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r e-n-t-r-y f-o-r w-i-n n-i-n-g r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-t-i-o-n o-f b-i-d i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e.
4) they c-o-v-e-r-e-d c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n a-r-r-a-n-g-e-m-e-n-t s and l-e-f-t i-n-v-o-i-c-e r-o-u-t-i-n-g t-o s-h-e-l-l e-n-t-i-t-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g p-a-y-m-e-n-t t-r-a-i-l a-u-d-i-t.
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e-d the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t a-s c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e and l-e-f-t s-t-a-g-e-d e-v-a-l-u-a-t-i-o-n m-e-m-o s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-a-i-r n-e-s-s r-e-v-i-e-w b-y a s-e-c-o-n-d r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r.
